about_the_game:
◆What Kind of Game Is This?

A romantic comedy where you play as a "love advisor" at a counselling office for a group of quirky, romantically challenged heroines. You, The protagonist, cool-headed and sharp-tongued, becomes a "temporary boyfriend". As you comment on their every move, you help them discover their true charms within—whether they like it or not.

◆Story

Down a shady alleyway in the city lies a suspicious-looking stairway to an underground office...

Nestled quietly at the end is a private love counseling agency known as "Making Lovely."

Here, the protagonist works as a "love advisor".

With a storefront like this, it's no surprise the clientele is anything but normal.

That's right—the only clients that come here are women that are walking red flags in the romance department.

"Let's get one thing straight—I won't be listening to any advice I don't like."

"Uh..............."

"Hehe, does that make you happy? ...Huh, it doesn't?"

"Heyoooo! I heard you're handing out boyfriends down here!"

Every last one of them is a disaster—quirky, awkward, and absolutely hopeless at love.

It's only natural they're still single... painfully so.

"From now on... you will have to treat me like I'm your boyfriend."

And so, the protagonist steps in.

Calling out their missteps, offering support, and pushing them forward—

all to help them uncover the hidden charms they have within.

◆Characters

○ Mei Isurugi

"Heyoooo! I heard you're handing out boyfriends down here!"

A hyper-energetic girl who lives on vibes alone.

She's endlessly cheerful and friendly, but her comedic instincts often go overboard.

A cheerful, clueless girl who hasn't even made it to the starting line as a woman, let alone in romance—

she came to the matchmaking agency thinking it was a place where they'd simply hand her a boyfriend.

Age: 20

Occupation: College student

Height: 155cm

Measurements (B-W-H): 84-52-78 (G-cup)

○ Sakuha Mayuzumi

"Let me guess, you're gonna say ‘fix that awful personality of yours,' like everyone else, right?"

A jaded, sharp-tongued woman guaranteed to miss her shot at marriage at this rate.

Grumpy, guarded, and easily flustered—behind her cool act lays a highly emotional girl, with lots of slip ups.

An arrogant, stubborn perfectionist with a clumsy streak.

Blacklisted by major counseling offices for being too much to handle.

Age: 23

Occupation: Freelancer

Height: 163cm

Measurements: 83-54-82 (F-cup)

○ Rinco Himenokoji

"Hehe, does that make you happy?"

Beautiful, intelligent, graceful, charming, sociable, and a little mischievousー

at first glance, she seems flawless, like an ideal partner

But her love runs way too deep, and she often spirals into obsessive behavior.

Even worse, she's completely unaware of how obsessive she can be—

a violent train of love and affection.

Age: 27

Occupation: Office worker

Height: 171cm

Measurements: 92-55-90 (H-cup)

○ Kohina Asahina

"I-I'll do my best…!"

Big breasts, tiny voice. A sweet, innoncent, kind-hearted girl with extreme social anxiety.

She's thoughtful and gentle, but can't speak up for herself

and stays silent unless spoken to.

Earnestly wants to change and follows the protagonist's advice with heartfelt dedication.

Age: 21

Occupation: Works at family-owned flower shop

Height: 149cm

Measurements: 98-58-78 (I-cup)

○ The Protagonist

"From now on… you will have to treat me like I'm your boyfriend."

A level-headed, highly competent advisor with a cool demeanor.

He becomes the "pseudo-boyfriend" for each heroine and interacts with them by "calling them out"

At times, correcting or scolding and other times encouraging, or pushing them forward., acting as needed

Name: Masaru Kazami (default, customizable)

Age: 25

Gender: Male

Occupation: Love advisor

Height: 175cm

◆Staff

Art: Oryo, Ruri Amane

Scenario: Ramune Games

Animation: Esojima, Nag

◆Guidelines for "Let's Play" and Other Video Form Content

Recording and uploading of "H-Scenes", unless granted exemption, is generally prohibited.

You may share content from all other parts of the game.

However, any content that could damage the reputation of the game or its creators is forbidden.

Examples of prohibited actions:

Editing content inappropriately

Revealing content outside the permitted range

Defaming third parties

Posting or compiling of edited or unedited H-scenes

!!! If you have purchased the R-18 DLC, turning off the "R-18 DLC” option in settings will revert the game to its base (non-adult) state. !!!

This game contains content that may be inappropriate for all age groups, including characters wearing revealing clothing.

All characters appearing in this game are 18 years of age or older.
